steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8085/ and sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin'. Report which page you land on after login and any visible navigation items.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Board' and open its board view. Report the names of the board's columns in their left-to-right order exactly as displayed on the board, and also report the titles of any task cards currently visible in each column. Do not modify or move anything.

03-create: On the 'Bench Board' project board, create a new task titled '{{runid}} Bench Task' with a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench task created for run {{runid}}'). Fill any required fields and submit. Then report the task's numeric ID as the app displays it (shown as #<number> on the task card or task page), the title, and confirm the description text saved. Do not touch the tasks whose titles start with 'Seed:'.

04-verify: On the 'Bench Board' board, move the task card '#4 {{runid}} Bench Task' from the {{03-create.column}} column into the '{{02-open.table_th_2}}' column (drag the card, or use the card's dropdown menu option to move it to that column). Verify afterwards that the card now sits in the '{{02-open.table_th_2}}' column and report the column header and the cards you see in it. Do not move or modify any task whose title starts with 'Seed:'.

05-open: Open the task page for task #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Task') on the 'Bench Board' project and add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit it and verify the comment appears on the task page; report the exact comment text shown and the number of comments on the task.

06-set: On the task page for task #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Task'), set the task's due date to 2026-12-31 (use the task's Actions menu or the due-date field; the app may present a date picker or a text field expecting YYYY-MM-DD). Save the change and verify the task page now displays the due date as 2026-12-31 (or Dec 31, 2026). Report exactly what the page shows for the due date.

07-edit: On task #4 ('{{runid}} Bench Task'), edit the task again and change the 'Date due' so that the time component is 00:00 (i.e. exactly 2026-12-31 00:00, or just the date 2026-12-31 with no time if the app allows). Save. Then report exactly what the task page sidebar shows for 'Due date'.

08-report: Final verification, read-only. Go to the 'Bench Board' project board and report: (1) the board column names left-to-right exactly as displayed; (2) which column the card '#4 {{runid}} Bench Task' is in and the exact card label; (3) the cards in each column. Then open task #4's task page and report: (4) the task title and numeric ID as displayed; (5) the description text; (6) the due date shown; (7) the comment text(s) shown. Do not modify anything.
